question: What range of desires does a thirteen-faced rudrākṣa fulfill?
premises: The thirteen-faced rudrākṣa is identified as Kāma
It is described as giving fruits of desires
Those desires are said to be all desires
inference: A thirteen-faced rudrākṣa, as Kāma, bestows the fruits of all desires.
plain_english: The thirteen-faced rudrākṣa is Kāma, the giver of the fruits of all desires.
